ROA_0928_final_no_velocity_scale0125.zero_velocity_code_unavailable_reason: This checkpoint was trained without an explicit velocity code; no code exists to zero.

primary_alignment.reason: Predeclared common alignment, matching archived approximate reconstruction; not fitted separately per policy

method.observation_layout: gyro*.25 [0:3], inverse-rotated gravity from recorded raw float32 quaternion [3:6], raw control input [6:9], q-default with wheel-position slots zero [9:19], dq*.05 [19:29], recorded previous raw action [29:39]
method.history: Oldest first; ROA 10 frames and DWAQ native last 5; initial frame repeated for unavailable preceding history; first 10 frames excluded from filled-history conclusions
method.shared_previous_action: All models see original ROA recorded previous actions; no predicted action fed back; older policies may receive out-of-distribution history
method.commands: Raw recorded control fields, no verified physical command calibration; same inputs for all policies
method.local_Jq: 2x2 d(hip target rad)/d(current hip position rad)
method.local_Jdq: 2x2 d(hip target rad)/d(current hip velocity rad/s)

modes.full_current: Perturb latest frame for both actor and encoder, past fixed
modes.actor_direct: Perturb only actor current-frame inputs; encoder codes held fixed
modes.history_only_coherent_bias: Apply same physical bias to all past hip observations, latest frame unchanged; 9 past frames for ROA, 4 for DWAQ
modes.all_history_coherent_bias: Apply same physical bias to every hip observation including current

method.gain_summary: Largest singular value of local 2x2 target Jacobian; units physical; not closed-loop gain, damping ratio, causal contribution or stability margin
method.signed_and_modal_metrics: Signed elementwise median matrices plus common and differential perturbation output norms retained; no stability inferred from sign
method.ablation: Freeze actor current hips while keeping codes; or freeze hips across all encoder/current frames; zero explicit velocity code only when present
method.target_differences: Differences strictly inside each stage; unnormalized per-step differences, no cross-window samples
method.configuration_contract: Every model's effective saved config checked for dimensions, scales, order, default offsets, history length, normalization and delay; strict checkpoint loading
method.previous_action_contract: Original recorded raw actions reused unchanged; no target-equivalent remapping or predicted feedback.

 method=dict(historical['method']);method.pop('action_scale',None)

 result={'version':1,'created_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'analysis_kind':'static_frozen_hardware_inputs','new_model':LABEL,'models':{LABEL:current},'reused_models':reused,'historical_policy_inference_count':0,'comparisons_vs_reused_models':comparisons,'method':method,'historical_results':legacy.ref(HIST),'previous_results':[legacy.ref(SEP26),legacy.ref(SEP28)],'data_refs':historical['data_refs'],'hardware_data_repository':{'root':str(data_repo),'head':current_head,'archived_head':archived_head,'worktree_clean':True,'all_referenced_input_bytes_unchanged':True},'checkpoint':legacy.ref(ck),'run_identity':legacy.ref(BASE/RUN/'evidence/source/identity-model29000-overlap-20260930-001.json'),'verification':{'historical_references_checked':checked,'autograd':validation,'reconstructed_inputs_match_archived_tolerance':ns['archive_input_error'],'weights_rng_and_gradient_buffers_unchanged':True},'analysis_source':{'python':DRIVER_SOURCE,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(DRIVER_SOURCE.encode()).hexdigest()},'recovered_kernel_sha256':hashlib.sha256(kernel.encode()).hexdigest(),'helper_source':source_ref,'artifacts':{'samples_npz':legacy.ref(npz),'per_frame_csv':legacy.ref(csvfile),'plot':legacy.ref(plot)},'runtime':{'conda_environment':'isaacsim-5.1','device':'CPU','elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-started},'limitations':historical['limitations']+['Current checkpoint is intermediate during training, not selected final policy.','Frozen Sep24 data is not a live hardware test of current policy.','Shared recorded .25 hip raw-action history may be out of distribution for .125 hip-scale policies; DWAQ additionally differs in history length.','Training configuration changed both estimator usage and joint-velocity noise; this comparison cannot isolate a causal contribution.'],'direct_parameter_change_supported':False,'policy_description_required':'仅可进入受监督实物测试；未经实物验证，不代表 hardware-ready。'}

 with np.load(npz,allow_pickle=False) as z:assert all(np.array_equal(z[k],v) for k,v in ns['arrays'].items())
 print(json.dumps({'metrics':legacy.ref(out/'metrics.json'),'vectors':vectors,'elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-started,'new_model':LABEL,'comparisons_growth':{label:comparisons[label]['growth'] for label in reused}},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
finally:signal.alarm(0)

limitations: This is a new static computation on the Sep24 incident, not reuse of numerical results from Sep18.
Latest approximate replay is not exact: missing true actor input times and sensor age; archived reconstruction has substantial hardware-target disagreement.
A static target prediction or frozen-input intervention cannot prove that any other policy would remain stable or avoid this hardware accident.
Recorded state and previous actions were produced by latest ROA; late growing states can be out of distribution for DWAQ and other ROA versions.
ROA native 10-frame and DWAQ native 5-frame history lengths are preserved, not artificially made equal.
Actuator delay is not simulated here; differences reflect learned networks/configurations, not a closed-loop delay experiment.
ROA Sep17 lacks an explicit velocity code; zero-code ablation is unavailable rather than a claimed zero effect.
Different training policies also changed rewards and other parameters; no isolated parameter causality or pure algorithm ranking.
No measured base linear velocity; code estimates cannot establish estimator accuracy.
Short onset/growth windows do not identify a mechanical resonance or provide statistical reliability.
No acceptance criteria establish convergence or hardware readiness.
Current checkpoint is intermediate during training, not selected final policy.
Frozen Sep24 data is not a live hardware test of current policy.
Shared recorded .25 hip raw-action history may be out of distribution for .125 hip-scale policies; DWAQ additionally differs in history length.
Training configuration changed both estimator usage and joint-velocity noise; this comparison cannot isolate a causal contribution.
